notesForTheReviewer: settingsClassifiedTypes is a hand-maintained list that claims to be every type reachable from config.Config; today it is (18 of 18, checked by a scratch reflect walk), but nothing in the suite enforces the reachability claim, so a new nested struct type whose parent field is classified `emitted` would have its own fields unclassified until someone adds the type to the list. Not a defect in the served behaviour; a one-loop hardening of TestSettingsOfClassifiesEveryConfigField if the reviewer wants it.

The settingsEmitted/settingsExcluded tables are documentary: the leak guard is the fixture's planted-marker sweep, the forbidden-key-name and `_file`-suffix sweep, and the exact key-set assertions at the top level, runtime.kubernetes and github_apps.implement. A credential field added later must also be planted in settingsFixtureFile for the sweep to see it.

The production check's lockstep: a daemon at contract 35 refuses a worker image at 34 at its boot gate, so the legion-deploy holder's release moves the binary and runtime.kubernetes.image together (the plan's Integration note); this round could not exercise it.
